_comment: S12 team montage. Every supplied photograph is used. Institution order is client-specified: Nahariya first, Rambam second, then the rest. Each institution's `photos` run as a group under one caption.

galilee.name: Galilee Medical Center
galilee.note: Host institution. Photos expected from client.

bnaizion.name: Bnai Zion Medical Center
bnaizion.note: bnaizion_02 is cropped to the left two-thirds, which removes the emoji sticker and the patient. bnaizion_01 is cropped to the right two-thirds, which removes the patient's face - the operators and monitors are all that remain, so the consent problem is gone.

hadassah.name: Hadassah Medical Organization
hadassah.note: hadassah_02 is cropped to the left 80%, dropping the foreground man who was cut through the skull by the frame edge.

poriya.name: Baruch Padeh Medical Center
poriya.note: Listed in the conference programme as Tzafon Medical Center, Baruch Padeh. The last three in the list carry visible blood - ordered last so they are the easiest to drop if the client wants them out.

closing_slot._comment: Final beat of S12, held longer under 'One goal.'
closing_slot.note: Swap to a Galilee wide shot once Nahariya photographs arrive.

review_notes: Every supplied photograph is in the montage. Three Poriya frames carry visible blood on drapes and gloves; fine for clinicians, a client call for an open lobby. They are last in the Poriya group, so removing them is three lines.
Employee ID badges are legible in several frames at 1080p. No blurring is applied; say the word and a badge-only blur goes in.
_montage_casting: Institutions with no photographs are skipped entirely. The remaining time is shared equally between every photograph, and each institution gets one caption held across its whole group rather than one per frame.
